TEXT:
[FI] "A new year has come, people are celebrating, I 
am unlike them."

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] - Kobayashi Issa

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] This is the Kousaka household, located somewhere 
in Chiba.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] In this residence, worried maidens assemble, 
seeking answers from the master of life, every night.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] Now then, I wonder who tonight's guest will be...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Mmm... *fidget* *fidget*...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Wh-What's the matter?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Grandpa, Grandpa...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Is dead...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Is dead but he's just playing dead!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] What's that, some kind of bad joke?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] It's not a joke at all. Whenever I go home, he's 
always playing dead.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] And lately he spits up red food coloring as blood, 
his methods are escalating...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Yesterday, he stuffed his head into a giant denture 
lying at the front gate and went limp.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Giant... denture?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] He made it out of Japanese candy... we didn't want 
to waste it, so we all decided to eat it.
[FI] ...To think your family still had the appetite to eat it.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] In the past, he said he wanted to revolutionize the 
Japanese confectionery scene... and make edible 
hair...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] I just worry that... you know, he's so old that he 
probably lost his mind.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...No, you don't have to worry.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] R-Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] He hasn't lost his sense of humor through all these 
years. In a way, this is something to be proud of.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Please treasure him well.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yes...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Umm... huh? Kyou-chan's dad...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Correct... but, here, you must call me Sensei.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] I take on young people's life troubles.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Wha-? No way, Kyou-chan's dad is the Life 
Counseling Master!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Hmm, well, I guess some say that.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Yes sir, Sensei!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Mmm, good answer.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Your visit means you must be bearing some kind of 
burden.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Rest assured, I can resolve any troubles that you 
might have.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] R-Really!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Umm, well I actually have a lot to worry about...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] A... lot, you say?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] No matter. Tell me all about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Well, stuff I just said about my Grandpa and 
there's... Grandma, my dad, Rock...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Also, my close childhood friend, his younger sister...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...So, what about them is troubling you?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] I just want them all to be healthy and happy.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Hm.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's... not a worry, but rather a wish.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Ah, I guess that's true... hehehe, you're right.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Oh and um, um...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You are always so worried about other people, but 
what about yourself?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Eh? Myself?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] You have a point~

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Hmm... I wonder?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] You know yourself best, I can't answer that for you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] R-Right...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] M-My worries about myself, huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Hmm... I can't think of anything after being put on 
the spot.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] People always come to me for help, so...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] In that case, what about something you wanted to 
discuss but never got the chance?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] If that's what you're asking... I have too many to 
mention.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] I guess you could say I'm too naive when it comes 
to helping others with their problems.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Naive?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Like, I just always want to sympathize with and 
forgive the person that I like, no matter what.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] On the other hand, even when I see a love rival 
having troubles, I want to help them.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hrm... that's certainly naive.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Sometimes I wonder if that might be bad.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] If we like the same guy, then we must have a lot in 
common, even our problems...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Rather than quarreling, I'm thinking more of, "Let's 
give it our best shot together".

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] ...That person probably won't like it though.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] ...I agree. From a different point of view, one might 
say you are pushing your values onto others, 
perhaps.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Y-You're right...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Maybe I'm actually a pushy woman...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] If you consider the future, though, that might not 
be a bad thing.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] But of course, not everyone shares the same 
feelings.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] I knew it...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Nevertheless, if you are holding back against others, 
it might be better for you to be hated instead.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Eeh?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You cooperate with your love rivals because quite 
possibly, you do not want the guy you like to hate 
you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] I just... want to be on good terms with everyone.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] But I guess... deep down it might be just as you 
say.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Perhaps I simply do not have enough confidence in 
myself.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] I want to be close to the person I like, even if 
people think I'm easy to manipulate... I thought that 
was fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I don't like it... especially that guy you've spoiled 
rotten.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] He wants you to be there to hear all his problems...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] ...and even for you to be friends with your rivals, just 
because it's convenient for him?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Well... I-I guess.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] What insolence...! I have to straighten him out!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] ...Am I... am I too nice?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yes, extremely nice. Especially towards others.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] There will come a time, that niceness will become 
your worst enemy.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] B-But... there are times where I really say what I 
think though?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Is the other person actually listening? Aren't the 
same mistakes happening over and over again?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Um well.. I don't know what to say.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You will have to be truthful towards that guy.  Tell 
him, "You are a piece of trash."

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Eeh?!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I firmly believe everyone's at fault. You, who can't 
speak her mind, that guy you are after, and all the 
girls wrapped up in this nonsense.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] First, I need to make you understand what your 
problems are.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Before all of it ends in tragedy.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] ...Ends in tragedy...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You might think you're helping them, but 
sometimes you need to tell them the truth. For 
better or worse.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] There cannot be any ambiguity on their end.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] If there's something you don't agree with, stay true 
to your principles and tell them straight.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You must understand that being earnest and telling 
them what they need to hear is the purest form of 
integrity.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] For better or worse, tell them...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] U-Understood!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] I won't worry about other people's feelings 
anymore!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] If he does something bad, I'll just be like BAM! 
POW! And get mad!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] When you should get angry, you really need to 
show it, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Well of course!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] After speaking to you, I feel so much better. Life 
counseling is amazing, huh~

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Well then, please excuse me. Good night~

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...There she goes.
[FI] ...Will she really be okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] Today's moral lesson!!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=30]If you don't like something, then say 
so. Always speak up for important 
things![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
[FI] And so, Daisuke has guided the path of another lost 
maiden. Let us meet on another moonlit night.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Still... I feel like I've seen that girl somewhere 
before...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] ...You really have no idea?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [FI] What do you mean?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] You're getting old too...

am unlike them."
